$comment: Model-facing output schema for POST /ai/refine (polish / split one existing task). Empty string means 'no change / no value'.

title.description: Improved title in Korean, or an empty string to keep the current title.

description.description: Improved description, or an empty string to keep the current one.

subtasks.description: Proposed new sub-steps to add. Empty if the request does not ask for splitting.

note.description: One short Korean sentence telling the user what was changed or why nothing was. Empty string if not needed.
